title: Cardputer Voice Input
summary: Press Fn + V to transcribe speech into supported apps.
description: Use Fn + V to start and stop recording, then insert the transcribed text into the focused input field. Choose DeepSeek or OpenAI (English) and switch configured providers with Shift + Fn + V. The settings app provides API key management, service controls and a shortcut guide. REC and ASR badges show progress; recording is canceled if the input target changes. Compatible with supported APPLaunch, ZClaw and CLI/ST builds; other apps may require adaptation. Requires an API key and network access. Audio is sent to the selected provider, whose pricing and data policies apply.
